name: Atoms Ecosystem Reference
summary: Complete reference guide to the *-atoms ecosystem: catalogs, their domains, primary atom types, relationships, and key conventions.

body.inline:
## What is the *-atoms ecosystem?

The *-atoms ecosystem is a collection of versioned, content-addressable catalog repositories hosted under the `convergent-systems-co` GitHub organization. Each catalog stores a distinct class of reusable primitives. Catalogs are deployed as static sites on Cloudflare Pages and are served from their own domain.

## Catalog inventory

| Catalog | Domain | Primary atom type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| schema-atoms | schema-atoms.com | json-schema, grammar | Normative JSON Schemas and grammar contracts for all catalogs |
| doc-atoms | doc-atoms.com | tutorial, explanation, runbook, how-to, reference-guide | Explanatory documentation for the ecosystem itself |
| persona-atoms | persona-atoms.com | persona | Stable AI agent identity definitions |
| prompt-atoms | prompt-atoms.com | prompt-fragment | Reusable AI prompt fragments |
| context-atoms | context-atoms.com | context | Context specifications for agent deployments |
| composition-atoms | composition-atoms.com | composition | Assembled agents from persona + fragments + context + tools |
| key-atoms | key-atoms.com | key | Cryptographic key references and rotation policies |
| action-atoms | action-atoms.com | action | Discrete agent action definitions |
| amendment-atoms | amendment-atoms.com | amendment | Governance amendment records |
| constitution-atoms | constitution-atoms.com | constitution | Constitutional governance documents |
| tool-atoms | tool-atoms.com | tool | Agent tool specifications and manifests |
| channel-atoms | channel-atoms.com | channel | Communication channel definitions for agent integrations |
| memory-atoms | memory-atoms.com | memory | Agent persistent memory specifications |
| workflow-atoms | workflow-atoms.com | workflow | Multi-step workflow definitions |
| event-atoms | event-atoms.com | event | Event schema definitions for async pipelines |

## Shared conventions

### Atom ID format

All atom IDs must match `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,62}[a-z0-9]$` — lowercase kebab-case, 3–64 characters. No slashes, no dots. IDs must be unique within a catalog.

### Version format

All atoms use SemVer: `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` or `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH-prerelease`. The version `0.1.0` is the canonical seed version for new atoms.

### Schema field

Every atom includes a `schema` field set to the catalog's atom schema URL (e.g., `https://doc-atoms.com/schemas/atom-v1.json`). This field is the discriminator used by validators and tooling to identify the expected schema.

### Required fields

Every atom, regardless of type, requires: `schema`, `type`, `id`, `version`, `name`.

## Shared infrastructure

| Component | Details |
|---|---|
| Hosting | Cloudflare Pages — one Pages project per catalog |
| State | Cloudflare R2 bucket `cs-tfstate` — shared Terraform state, keyed per catalog |
| Signing | 1Password vault "Convergent Systems LLC" — root signing key for all catalogs |
| CI secrets | `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` and `CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID` at org level |
| Label standards | `convergent-systems-co/repo-standards` — canonical label definitions and aliases |
| Infrastructure provisioning | Terraform in each catalog's `infra/` directory |

## Catalog relationships

```
schema-atoms  ──→  all catalogs (provides JSON Schema validation contracts)
persona-atoms ─┐
prompt-atoms  ─┤
context-atoms ─┼──→  composition-atoms (assembled into agent compositions)
tool-atoms    ─┘
composition-atoms  ──→  deployed agents (consumed by runtime pipelines)
doc-atoms     ──→  contributors and operators (ecosystem documentation)
```

## Release lifecycle

1. Develop on a `feat/*` branch in a worktree
2. Validate atoms: `python3 scripts/validate.py`
3. Sign atoms: `node scripts/sign-atoms.mjs`
4. Open PR, wait for CI green
5. Merge with merge commit (no squash)
6. Tag: `git tag vX.Y.Z && git push origin vX.Y.Z`
7. Release workflow deploys to Cloudflare Pages and publishes GitHub Release

## Naming conventions

| Artifact | Convention | Example |
|---|---|---|
| Catalog repo | `<domain>-atoms` | `persona-atoms` |
| Atom ID | kebab-case | `customer-success-specialist` |
| Grammar atom ID | `<catalog>-v<major>` | `persona-atoms-v1` |
| Worktree | `feat/<slug>` | `feat/v0.1-seed` |
| Release tag | `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` | `v0.1.0` |
